project.name: Jarvis AI
project.purpose: Multimodal AI assistant with chat, live voice/video call, dual-screen live translation, TTS studio, personal knowledge base + RAG, semantic search, and GitHub Gist 2-way sync.

architecture.pattern: module-based vanilla JS, shared state exposed on window, IndexedDB for persistence, localStorage for settings/keys, native bridge in Android WebView
external_apis: Google Gemini (chat + BidiGenerateContent live streaming + TTS + embeddings)
OpenRouter / Experiential Labs (OpenAI-compatible chat completions + streaming)
Tavily / Serper / Jina / Brave (web search and content extraction)

files.index.html: Main UI skeleton: sidebar, header, chat, modals, input panel, file upload, transcript, token/latency bar, search/memory toggles. Loads js/eventBus.js before js/rag.js.
files.manifest.json: PWA manifest (icons, display, theme color, app name, start URL).
files.sw.js: Service Worker: static asset cache, network-first for HTML/JS/CSS, bypass for live/API/search endpoints, cache CDN libs.
files.css/style.css: Core UI styles, layout, sidebar, chat bubbles, modals, inputs, theme variables.

features.name: Chat, sessions, models, core app logic

files.js/app.js: Main controller: session management, chat history, rendering (markdown + thinking blocks), model/engine selection, API key wiring, OpenAI-compatible gateway (OpenRouter with streaming and reasoning), system instruction + global context, temperature/top-p/top-k/thinking level, file attachments, auto-naming, auto-summary, branch-forking, hands-free voice recorder + VAD, token/latency counters, DOM helpers, PWA SW registration, localStorage quota handling, native bridge sync hooks.
files.js/database.js: IndexedDB persistence for sessions and related stores, init + CRUD helpers.
files.js/api-keys.js: API key pool UI + storage (Google key rotation and quota tracking) plus external API key storage (Tavily, Serper, Experiential Labs, OpenRouter).
files.js/commands.js: Command palette / prompt library / slash-command routing helpers.
files.js/tools.js: Search cache, Tavily/Serper helpers, web page + YouTube content extraction, blob save/share, copy helpers, export helpers.

files.js/live.js: Gemini bidirectional live WebSocket (BidiGenerateContent), PCM streaming (16kHz in, 24kHz playback), camera streaming, live speech recognition, farewell/silence hangup detection, tool calls for search_web/read_url, key rotation on disconnect, transcript capture synced back to chat.

files.js/translate.js: Bilingual interpretation via Gemini live translate/bidirectional model, speaker toggle, VU meter, local SpeechRecognition transcript, model/key fallback, guest language selection, screen flip helper.

files.js/tts.js: Gemini TTS studio, voice presets, expression tags, smart chunking, WAV construction, MP3 encode (lamejs), visualizer, playback, IndexedDB TTS library, history list with play/download/delete.

features.name: Personal knowledge base, RAG, embeddings, semantic search

files.js/rag.js: Gemini Embedding 2 (+ fallback embedding-001), IndexedDB vector store, document chunking with overlap, indexing with progress, hybrid vector + lexical search, smart intent filter for personal-identity queries, context retrieval for chat, auto-learn memory extraction, persona synthesis, knowledge modal UI. Search is worker-first: searchSimilarVectors routes through js/rag.worker.js and falls back to searchSimilarVectorsMain on the main thread; both paths share computeHybridScore so ranking stays identical.

features.name: Cross-module Event Bus + RAG Web Worker (performance)

files.js/eventBus.js: Lightweight pub/sub event bus exposed as window.EventBus; emits app:ready once core modules are loaded; loaded in index.html before js/rag.js. Optional adoption - existing modules are not forced to migrate; bus is for light cross-module signals only (no large state).
files.js/rag.worker.js: Web Worker computing cosine similarity + hybrid scoring off the main thread; single message handler; keeps RAG search responsive on large knowledge bases. Mirrored to android/app/src/main/assets/js/.

features.name: GitHub Gist 2-way sync and multi-device merge

files.js/sync.js: GitHub Gist 2-way sync with smart merge for sessions, knowledge base, folders, prompts, API keys/external configs, key-usage counters, medications + med history, tombstone handling, rate-limit recovery, background auto-sync, startup sync, pull/push restore flows, sync header status.

features.name: Android WebView wrapper and medication reminders

files.android/gradle.properties: Gradle JVM args + AndroidX/R class settings.
files.android/app/build.gradle: App module config: versioning, permissions, packaging, WebView assets.
files.android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml: Permissions and components: alarms, notifications, boot receiver, WebView activity.
files.android/app/src/main/java/com/kevinkieu/: WebView setup, JS bridge for native persistence/alarms, medication reminder integration.
files.android/app/src/main/res/*: UI resources: layout, strings, colors, themes, icons.
files.android/app/src/main/assets/*: Bundled web app assets for offline APK (index.html, manifest, sw.js, css/, js/ incl. eventBus.js + rag.worker.js mirrors, icons). Kept in sync with the web root by build.js/build-apk.bat and CI.
files.build-apk.bat: Windows build script: runs node bump-version.js, syncs web assets into Android assets, auto-detects JAVA_HOME/ANDROID_HOME, runs gradlew.bat assembleRelease, copies APK to project root as JarvisAI.apk / JarvisAI_Offline.apk.
files.build.js: Cross-platform Node build script: bump-version.js, copies index.html/manifest.json/sw.js/icons/js/css into Android assets, then gradlew assembleRelease (gradlew.bat on Windows) and copies APK to project root. Requires JDK 17 + Android SDK locally.
files..github/workflows/build-apk.yml: GitHub Actions CI building the APK automatically (behaviour documented in developer_workflow.ci_cd).
files.install-phone.bat: Install built APK to device via USB ADB.
files.install-phone-wifi.bat: Install built APK to device via Wi-Fi debugging ADB.

files.boicanhduan.json: This project context file (reference snapshot for new sessions).
files.scratch/test_browser.js: Likely a quick browser/launch test helper.
files..well-known/assetlinks.json: Android app links / asset links metadata.

browser.localStorage: Settings, API keys (optionally obfuscated), folders, tabs, theme, sync config, medication data, deleted-id tombstones, key usage data
browser.indexeddb: Chat sessions, knowledge/vector store, TTS history, file/TTS-related stores

android.webview: Runs the same web app with bundled assets
android.native: AlarmManager/NotificationManager for medication reminders, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED rescheduling, notification actions (taken/snooze), JS bridge for persistence

developer_workflow.local_run: Serve the project via a local HTTP server (for example Python http.server / npx serve) and open index.html.
developer_workflow.pwa_install: Install from browser via manifest/Service Worker.
developer_workflow.android_build: Three options: (1) node build.js cross-platform (needs JDK 17 + Android SDK; chmod +x gradlew on first run); (2) build-apk.bat on Windows; (3) push to main or workflow_dispatch so GitHub Actions builds the APK (artifact JarvisAI-Android-App + GitHub Release). Note: a sandboxed environment without Android SDK/Gradle cannot produce the APK locally.
developer_workflow.android_deploy: Use install-phone.bat (USB ADB) or install-phone-wifi.bat (Wi-Fi debugging ADB) to install a built APK to a connected device.
developer_workflow.version_bump: Run bump-version.js to increment Android versionCode/versionName and sync cache busters in index.html and sw.js.
developer_workflow.ci_cd: .github/workflows/build-apk.yml builds the APK on push to main/master when android/**, js/**, css/**, index.html, manifest.json, sw.js or the workflow itself change, or via manual workflow_dispatch. Behaviour after hardening (commit a7d55c4): deterministic version bump (versionCode = current + 1 read via awk, versionName 1.1.X, no github.run_number), assembleRelease preferred, on failure builds debug and labels it JarvisAI-debug.apk; uploads artifact JarvisAI-Android-App (30-day retention); creates GitHub Release v1.1.X with dynamic notes + generate_release_notes only when the release build succeeds. Pushing boicanhduan.json alone does NOT trigger this workflow (not in its paths filter).

recent_changes.summary: Tối ưu độ trễ nhánh Google (generateContentStream): gửi thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel (kèm includeThoughts) cho Gemini 3.x/4 thay vì thinkingBudget cũ, giảm round-trip retry do sai tham số; maxOutputTokens mặc định 32768 -> 8192 (giữ 65000 riêng cho gemini-3.5-flash-lite); số tin ngữ cảnh mặc định 16 -> 10 khi người dùng chưa tự nhập (js/app.js + index.html). Đã mirror sang android/app/src/main/assets/.

Loại bỏ hoàn toàn nền tảng NVIDIA: xóa optgroup model, ô NVIDIA API Key và NVIDIA Base URL trong Cài đặt hệ thống (index.html), nhà cung cấp nvidia trong COMPAT_PROVIDERS + logic nvidia_base_url và thông báo lỗi CORS trong js/app.js, entry nvidia_api_key/nvidia_base_url trong cfgMap (js/app.js, js/api-keys.js) và danh sách backup (js/export.js), cập nhật ghi chú sync. Thêm 2 model OpenRouter: google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it:free (Gemma 4 26B A4B) và google/gemma-4-31b-it:free (Gemma 4 31B). Giữ nguyên mask nvapi- trong js/cipher.js để bảo vệ key lịch sử chat cũ. Đã mirror sang android/app/src/main/assets/.

Đồng bộ & mã hóa NVIDIA key (nvidia_api_key) ngang các nền tảng khác. js/sync.js: thêm bước so sánh settings.externalConfigs (giải mã JVENC_ trước khi so) để máy có key mới/đổi key được đẩy lên Gist ngay cả khi chưa có tin nhắn chat mới (trước đây key mới không bao giờ tới Cloud). js/export.js: thêm nvidia_api_key vào danh sách cấu hình được mã hóa trong bản sao lưu JSON. js/cipher.js: che mẫu nvapi- trong lịch sử chat. js/api-keys.js: hẹn auto-sync sau khi bấm Lưu Cấu Hình. Đã mirror sang android/app/src/main/assets/js/.

RAG search is worker-first (new js/rag.worker.js; js/rag.js has worker path + searchSimilarVectorsMain fallback, shared computeHybridScore). Added js/eventBus.js exposing window.EventBus and emitting app:ready, loaded in index.html before rag.js. Added cross-platform build.js; build-apk.bat now runs node bump-version.js first. Mirrors updated under android/app/src/main/assets/.

Hardened .github/workflows/build-apk.yml: deterministic version bump (no github.run_number), separated release/debug APK naming, GitHub Release only on successful release build, dynamic release notes with generate_release_notes, fetch-depth 0 checkout.
Removed broken Orcarouter provider (later replaced by an NVIDIA OpenAI-compatible gateway, which was itself removed on 2026-11-17 in favour of OpenRouter).
